note: Where ClaimClear has decided against a dev case's answer key. The answer files are left as they are (they are Member 1's); the dev run labels these cases and still counts them as misses.

decisions.decided: The proportionate deduction follows IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/151/06/2020: pharmacy and consumables, implants and medical devices, diagnostics and ICU charges are never cut, and only a room above its cap triggers the cut.
decisions.answer_key: Follows the case's printed wording (clause 4.1 Note 2: only the cost of medicines is spared) and its own DECISIONS #1 and #2: consumables, implants and diagnostics are cut, by the lower of the room and ICU ratios.
decisions.why: The circular binds every insurer and a policyholder can rely on it in a grievance or before the Ombudsman; the standard product as filed now (Go Digit's copy) carries the same exemptions.
